content: Database-table-backed job queues (instead of Redis) are a recognized pattern for single-instance/low-throughput deployments. Key technique: atomic claim via UPDATE...WHERE status=pending...RETURNING (or SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED equivalent) to avoid race conditions between workers. Throughput ceiling is roughly 100-200 jobs/sec before lock contention -- far above UP-Fix's 500 tickets/day target, so SQL Server job_queue table is a sound choice matching SPEC.md §5.7.
